item.title: ‘Marshals’ star Luke Grimes admits he was ‘worried’ about doing ‘Yellowstone’ spinoff without on-screen wife
item.description: An image collage containing 3 images, Image 1 shows Luke Grimes was worried about doing the Yellowstone spinoff Marshals without Kelsey Asbille as Kayce Dutton begins moving on from Monica's death, Image 2 shows Beth Dutton (Kelly Reilly), John Dutton (Kevin Costner), Monica Long (Kelsey Asbille), Jamie Dutton (Wes Bentley), Kayce Dutton (Luke Grimes), and Rip Wheeler (Cole Hauser) appear in a promotional image for season 2 of "Yellowstone" on Oct. 23, 2018, Image 3 shows Grimes revealed that reprising his role without Kelsey Asbille, who played Monica Dutton throughout "Yellowstone," was one of his biggest concerns about the spinoff
